notes.title: The Dark Congregation Rises! Weekly Update
notes.content:
[p]Hi! [/p][p]This week I continue working on the cave system and its inhabitants. My current focus is the monster known as [b]The Dark Congregation.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Dark Congregation[/b][/h3][p]The Dark Congregation is a massive Dark One whose body is formed from a swarm of smaller monsters clustered around a glowing red relic. Deep in the cave system, their combined Dark Energy creates a halo above its head.[/p][p]Long ago, an ancient miniature civilization mistook this halo as divine — a belief that ultimately led to their destruction. Wielding a staff of solidified golden syrup, the Dark Congregation strikes its own halo to conjure waves of devastating magic.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Original Design[/b][/h3][p]This was the first take on the Dark Congregation — already creepy, with the clustered body and glowing relic.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/a868568235533f6aa13d2cc0f1c7624cda105f55.png"][/img][/p][p]
[b]Refined Design + Idle Animations[/b][/p][p][/p][p]In the updated design, you can see a lot more presence: the staff is larger and more ornate, the cloak and form are more defined, and the halo effect feels sharper. The new Idle animations bring him to life, making the whole creature feel even more ominous.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/5e8a9c49699640dce8adce072e4e2f6625d08252.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Projectile Attack Animation[/b][/h3][p]Here’s one of it's new attack animations — an updated version of his projectile attack. When his staff hits the ground a magical golden orb is expelled towards his target.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/9c2f1d9cd1f7c50da89013ee87626acd8e970a26.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Secondary Attack Animation[/b][/h3][p]His secondary staff attack will make traps appear around him that you may also be able to use against him and his horde of followers. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/2f0b24c713c2d7367b8db66b848c0ddc5cb861c8.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for now on The Dark Congregation! I’ll be sharing more of his progress — including new attack patterns and abilities — in the next update post, so stay tuned.

James -  @iENDERi[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: ✨ Bombing my way Into the Caves – Weekly Update
notes.content: [p][b]Hi everyone,[/b] James here with another weekly [i]Adventure Craft[/i] dev update![/p][p][/p][p]In this video I try to [b]bomb my way into the new cave system[/b] to show you how things are shaping up underground. The caves were one of the very first things I built for the game, and over time they got left a little incomplete as I focused more on the surface. With the next update they’re getting a [b]full overhaul[/b].[/p][p]Now the caves will feature:[/p][list][*][p]A [b]variety of Gem Biomes[/b] you can search and mine[/p][/*][*][p]Updated artwork for stalagmites, pillars, rocks, and treasure chests[/p][/*][*][p]Ancient ruins from a lost civilization you can explore and break apart[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]gem deposits[/b] (and special pickaxes to mine them)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gem monstrosities[/b] and other new enemies guarding these areas[/p][/*][*][p]And plenty of tweaks to make the caves [b]more dangerous but way more rewarding[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Everything in the footage is still work-in-progress — I’m testing with debug items (and blowing myself up with bombs way too often 😅). But hopefully this gives you a taste of how much deeper and more alive the caves will feel.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="nXBqZocHu48;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Here are some screenshots! Almost all of the art assets in the caves are being updated to match the overall look of the rest of the game. I’ve always loved making creepy stuff, so it’s been a lot of fun applying my current pixel art skills down here.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/224834751c761f65fa0b2d6865f016097c879ad6.png"][/img][/p][p]The new cave system will have [b]14 different Gem Biomes[/b] to discover, each with its own unique set of enemies. These areas are always in conflict thanks to the mining operations going on down here, so expect things to get pretty chaotic when you explore.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/c8effe4e34358bdeedcb275f09fecd089798fda1.png"][/img][/p][p]There’s also a full set of [b]Crystal Armor[/b] and a variety of [b]Crystal Weapons[/b] tied to each gem type. You’ll run into crystal warriors down here too, and they’re not alone — each one has a [b]Crystal Monstrosity pet[/b] by their side.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/e5ce48b89a7372915c2ba67ef6033c4b37a7e38d.png"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Dark Ones[/b] will show up in much greater numbers now, making the caves a constant danger. Exploring underground won’t just be about mining — you’ll always have to stay on your toes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/1df413128ebe754b12d5fccb8c498a47332b74f1.png"][/img][/p][p]To balance out the danger, there’ll be a variety of [b]treasure chests[/b] hidden around the caves to make exploring more rewarding (and to keep you pushing deeper).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/6334cc2afe3560205aeae6e295704a6389d8566f.png"][/img][/p][p]That’s it for this week’s update! Thanks so much for checking out the progress — it means a lot to me. Your feedback and support are a big part of what keeps me working on this game after all these years.[/p][p]I’ll be sharing more updates soon as I polish things further. In the meantime, let me know what you think of the new caves and which features you’re most excited to try.[/p][p]See you in the next one![/p][p]– James @iENDERi[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.24 (Sound Effects)
notes.content:
Being one of only two people working on this game has required me to wear many hats over the years. Which is good because I love hats.

But one hat that I haven't worn in a long time was the sound effects hat. This is sad because sound effects have such a huge effect on how a game feels. Sound connects the player to the world in a way that only it can. It brings personality to the game world and communicates more to the player in many cases than the visuals alone allowing the player to feel more connected to the world.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/1826aa1550701077d07a19d12a655d7adab5174e.png[/img]


The content in the game has grown considerably over time and was in dire need of many more sounds. We didn't have enough time to include the sound update in 1.23 so we decided to complete it now before we move on to other things. So I'm very happy to report that we have added a ton of new sounds to many aspects of the game for version 1.24


Sound design is not really my area of expertise however I have attempted to really immerse myself into the process and have worked to try and pick nice quality sounds that enrich the game experience. I also have had a close friend who is learning the sound engineering ropes lending me a hand. The initial results have felt very good and have made the game world feel much richer and more alive, and also much more humorous at times.

We have updated many aspects of the sound effects including...

[b]Characters Idle Sounds[/b]
Each character in Adventure Craft has a slot for multiple Idle sounds. This is a collection of sounds that they can make when they are just hanging around, helping the player to become aware of their presence. We had a look at nearly every character and faction and have updated their sounds to give them more personality. 

So now for example when you are near Punks you will hear them make little Negative "Heh"s or when you are near Special Forces you will hear their radio chatter calling out Bravo! Echo! etc. Cockroaches and spiders hiss and skitter and Lumberjack Mechs rev their chainsaw engines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/a119e47cdff6d91f6c734e8e54b5ad72ff5496f6.png[/img]



More dangerous enemies like werewolves have a warning sound slot, so you may hear a howling sound when one is near.

[b]Character Attacks[/b]
We have updated many enemy attacks to have new sounds like slicing sharp blade noises and crunchy and booming impacts to bring extra impact and weight to their attacks.  

[b]Weapons [/b]
We have updated the swinging and impact sounds for many weapons so that hitting someone over the head with a pipe sounds different than hitting them over the head with a wooden sword.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/18ff5c6e78c44c2f1206c7c64f6bf2f256d3675d.png[/img]

And there is more to come.

It is still a work in progress so there is plenty of room for further improvement so please leave me any feedback about how the game sounds now so that we can continue to enhance the sound over future updates. 

Twitter: @iENDERi

notes.title: Adventure Craft 1.2 is Now Available!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

We are happy to announce that the Adventure Craft update 1.2 is now available. We have made some big changes and improvements to the overall game as well as added lots of new free content for you to enjoy. Let’s dive right in.

[h1]Adjusted Early Game Area[/h1]

We have greatly reduced the difficulty of the spawn area where you begin the game. Allowing new players the chance to get into the game before the difficulty begins to ramp up outside the spawn and beyond.

[h1]New Dying Mechanic[/h1]

The first big change is an update to the game’s dying mechanic. For a while, I have felt that death is too abrupt and disconcerting. Especially when things are chaotic or it’s nighttime. There are many enemies that are strong enough to kill you instantly which can feel pretty annoying especially if you have healing items in your inventory.

So now instead of dying instantly when your character’s health is reduced to zero, you will instead go into the “Dying” status effect. This status effect will cause a Grim Reaper to appear above your head along with a 7-second countdown timer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/eab6c6789246370b1a6520afe9cdeece664ba2b4.png[/img]

Enemies will stop attacking you during the effect and you won’t be able to attack until you use a healing item to return some of your health and stop the reaper.

This gives you an opportunity to use a healing item from your Hotbar before the reaper ends your life and sends you back to the last bed that you slept in. So now you will have a chance to choose whether or not to continue fighting in a situation or go ahead and die to be sent back to the last bed that you slept in.

[b]Note: Dying is different from the Doomed Status Effect which can only be cured by eating a Grim Biscuit[/b]

[h1]Scenario and Event Spawning Overhaul[/h1]

In order to create a more varied and lively game world, we have completely overhauled our event and enemy spawning mechanics for the majority of the Tile Maps in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/5f95a4a40191216f65823fde3263d64090fc2845.png[/img]

The new system creates a much greater variety of enemy interactions more frequently resulting in much more action and more interesting situations for the player to take advantage of ... or run away from!

It also paves the way for us to continuously update content in a way that’s easier for us to enrich the game world for the players and increase the likelihood of players seeing more content.

[h1]Phantom Dark Vaults Nighttime Update[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/4bc17eb2b51c02ed35956d6dcd6e586d7563029f.jpg[/img]

The Event Spawning Overhaul also extends to the night with the inclusion of Dark Vaults and Phantoms. 

During the night you may now encounter Dark Vaults: large gilded crypts sealed by golden chains. Attacking these vaults yields special Dark Vault materials that can be used to make very rare Dark Vault Weapons and Items. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/13353052730b65aad4889096a8e63f0b098eff17.jpg[/img]

A Dark Vault is similar to a standard Treasure chest. It can be struck up to 5 times. It has a loot table per hit for the first 4 times that you strike it and a separate loot table for the 5th blow which contains all the Dark Vault Recipes. If you choose to strike a Dark Vault 5 times the final blow will open it unleashing a large horde of powerful enemies and potentially a Dark Phantom.

Some Dark Vaults are protected by NPC’s and may even occasionally be opened accidentally by mobs fighting near them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/7401d739331dd23b9e9f66d92f17447362c2851f.jpg[/img]


[h1]Dark Phantoms[/h1]
Dark Phantoms are a new class of Darkness Enemies that are very powerful and have the ability to significantly alter the tilemap in which they have appeared, transforming enemies and world objects into unique mobs and other objects that yield very rare Dark Vault loot and recipes. There are 12 Dark Phantoms in production at the moment and one is included in this update. The remaining Dark Phantoms will be added in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/81485d038cea68f6d5c49c275174e25ccbb230a7.png[/img]

The first Dark Phantom included in this update is...

[h1]King Hemlock[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/d8f1a6888b755d9a6726e6d1838f1d202b3f2faa.png[/img]


[b]“King Hemlock was an evil King. He poisoned nearly everything. Until his subjects poisoned [i]him [/i]which made his lifeforce very dim”[/b]

There are [b]15 Total Dark Vaults[/b] in this update, three of which King Hemlock is guaranteed to emerge from. King Hemlock may also emerge from any of the other Dark Vaults if they are opened before midnight.

King Hemlock’s melee attack can permanently transform trees into “Hemlock’s Kitchen” an enemy spawner from which the Servants of Hemlock will spawn at night. Servants of Hemlock will wander around deploying “Strange Pots” and pools of poison. Mobs that they kill with their Pot Spoon weapon may be transformed into Strange Pots as well. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/8678ec362b07b843816233bd1f1140c3aeb647d8.jpg[/img]

Defeating Servants of Hemlock will yield the items needed to craft your own Pot Spoon that you can then use to smash the pots that they generate for rare Dark Vault items. They also may drop Hemlock Gems on death which can be used to craft Dark Vault Weapons like King Hemlock’s Sword, a weapon that King Hemlock himself is vulnerable to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/a05a9c06181d2582dcb9ecb9983e7f22c7588467.jpg[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/19d5b9fbd1d972ae70c148eb6fd2d2d87eb63c37.jpg[/img]

King Hemlock’s sword makes him much easier to defeat and he also drops Hemlock Gems on Death. Defeating Hemlock also has a chance to drop his mask which allows you to build an Alter of Hemlock which will spawn one instance of him at night.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/7ef05943c0185887553fb401fbe6d9ab4a8c1c34.png[/img]

[h1]Dark Vault Weapons[/h1]
There are 9 Dark Vault Weapons available in this update. These are very powerful weapons that allow access to special loot only available through their use and may eventually allow access to areas that are inaccessible without them.

Hemlock’s Sword
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/ff3060f05b195665225d737e3a433e4cbe560a39.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/b8136a03b9f951e69b2f87947558880888903a83.jpg[/img][/url]
The Pot Spoon
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/742b3c7dd516d5bda700be697c99f76a1aee7f9f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/46f2346809802e05ad070c4b4bbd567b82830606.jpg[/img][/url]
The Royal Spoon
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/24938dedae6e4ea1daa4211ba8dfb5c0cc1b3c09.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/f93f687cf8c6bb1aa40ca49dfc7d013f49c773c4.jpg[/img][/url]
The Burning Bite
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/5d79a6601f8974fbc191d9ea8e90b89d6f112988.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/0241775f6f9cdc32c79bdb71ba3fdf35ab59954e.jpg[/img][/url]
The Crystalline Blade
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/7455ef6ac13a10f16e9aadd80fab0fff5a2df5c1.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/1980835ba99599ea881fb5bc6e77d0e887c5ec34.jpg[/img][/url]
The Doomblade
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/b22fd36f7a988e809fa46f2d47aa3d7012ce89a0.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/b0409c3a5bf92d063ccb3d2aa43ef66442e535eb.jpg[/img][/url]
The Ill Severance
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/37431b2d307f01f07722a5a953754325da2c243f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/c4f98b2d78f5aa7800c15f4eaaf37e423117c437.jpg[/img][/url]
The Netherbane
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/f50fc231a5911c62682ae48f5e284df33c564cc9.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/993f9f51803bcee42e13ed107024b9e98ba684e5.jpg[/img][/url]
The Nogginbrand
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/9ded0253a76714976c67d6fca4954c227887ce89.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/dd4428d87158daf3dd99fd9dd31e9e814061f2c0.jpg[/img][/url]
[h1]Dark Vault Weapon Rarity and Player Item Trading[/h1]
As the other Phantoms are introduced into the game, it will affect the rarity of these already rare items due to the fact that they will also come from the Dark Vaults so engaging with the Vaults early may have a significant effect on how easy it is for you to acquire these items after future updates. Being able to craft these items in the future may require trading items between players which we are working on and will tell you more about soon.

[b]More Friendly NPC’s[/b]

We have added more friendly NPC’s and greatly increased the overall frequency and probability that you will encounter helpful NPC’s. It’s also now easier to tell if an NPC is friendly because you will see hearts popping out of their heads. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/a47e2ce698e482dba188a84eb998a43eb5ceed0e.jpg[/img]


[b]Graphical updates[/b]
We have updated many of the game’s graphical assets as well as added new areas to be explored. The Mushmen Faction for example now features Red, Green and Purple camps for the ever-evolving Mushmen War.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/d64c3d804ed2108751877d9f90a445d73d1b2a42.png[/img]


[b]New Enemies and Animals[/b]
There are several new enemy types including Undead Brutes which can occur when a Brute class humanoid is infected by a zombie. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/e28f1bbf5830765b612a2fa557dedc7d8e678ed2.png[/img]

There is also a rare Deer. The chance to see a deer is very rare but you can tell if one is near if you see deer tracks on the ground. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/3ec4e2af4a55823964f4e09d29f58ac06428dbf6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Secondary Attacks - Weapon Update[/h1]


We have updated most weapons with a new kind of attack called a [b]Secondary Attack[/b]. For most weapons, there is a 40% chance that a Secondary Attack will occur. 

You can tell a secondary attack occurred by the dramatic sting sound effect that plays when the attack connects and by the significantly increased knockback effect that sends the enemy flying much further away from you than the standard attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/126e4035f38ff9793d571cd13d1a0dea13f74aee.jpg[/img]

From a visual standpoint, secondary attacks also have a unique attack effect graphic that says[b] BAM![/b]

Secondary Attacks are unique for each weapon and all have independent statistical probabilities for things like Damage, Critical Chance, Transformation Chance, Status Effects, and so on allowing us to really enhance a weapon’s personality and fun.

[h1]Magical Spellbooks[/h1]

We have also added a new class of Magical Weapon to the game in the form of Magic Spellbooks. The first two which are in this update are the Ignite and Fireball Spellbooks. Spellbooks unleash very powerful attacks and thus are a challenge to craft. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/43a9b7471d67b3df10f685b17ab033cc6bd91be3.png[/img]


[b]To Create a Spellbook[/b]

Create Bark Sheets by cutting a Rotten Log

Place Bark Sheets into a Forge to produce Handmade Paper
 
Crush 5 Begrimed Skulls into a piece of Handmade Paper to create a sheet of Begrimed Paper

Crush 25 Sheets of Begrimed Paper with 2 Iron Bars and 10 Nails to create Bound Begrimed Paper

Next combine 1 Bound Begrimed Paper, 25 Dark Skin, 10 Twine, 5 Nails, and 10 Red Slime to create a Blank Spellbook.

Once you have a Blank Spellbook you can craft it into a Magical Spellbook weapon that can cast powerful magic spells.

There are two Magical Spellbooks available in this release. Fireball and Ignite

[b]Fireball I[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/a56238bb7fa3b3467f391253d5e07219cf0e7564.jpg[/img]

Combine a Blank Spellbook and 25 Fire Crystals to create a “Fireball I” Magical Spellbook

The Fireball I Spellbook launches fireball projectiles that damage enemies with a high chance to cause burning. Some enemies hit with a fireball may be instantly transformed into a pile of ash.

You can also upgrade the Fireball I Magical Spellbook by combining it with additional 25 fire crystals to create Fireball II. 

Combining the  Fireball II Spellbook  with an additional 50 Fire Crystals upgrades it to Fireball III

[b]Ignite I[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/e86c1eabc432518031114077d16f5244d5c2c14c.jpg[/img]

Combine a Blank Spellbook, 25 Fire Crystals, and 25 Gunpowder to create an “Ignite I” Magical Spellbook.

Ignite is an area of effect spell that damages all enemies within its radius with a very high chance to cause burning. Enemies hit with Ignite also have a high chance to be transformed into a pile of ash.

Magic Spellbooks can be repaired with Mana Bottles which can be found in chests or purchased in some shops.


[b]And MORE![/b]
There’s a bunch of additional stuff in this update that I haven’t mentioned and that I’ll leave for you to discover as well as some very VERY exciting new announcements that we will be making soon. 


As usual, deploying a new update may create bugs or issues in a game like this so please be sure to report anything that is crashing in the discussions forum or to me directly via Twitter @iENDERi and we will address it as soon as we can.

tags.feature: So now instead of dying instantly when your character’s health is reduced to zero, you will instead go into the “Dying” status effect. This status effect will cause a Grim Reaper to appear above your head along with a 7-second countdown timer.
Enemies will stop attacking you during the effect and you won’t be able to attack until you use a healing item to return some of your health and stop the reaper.

This gives you an opportunity to use a healing item from your Hotbar before the reaper ends your life and sends you back to the last bed that you slept in. So now you will have a chance to choose whether or not to continue fighting in a situation or go ahead and die to be sent back to the last bed that you slept in.

The new system creates a much greater variety of enemy interactions more frequently resulting in much more action and more interesting situations for the player to take advantage of ... or run away from!
It also paves the way for us to continuously update content in a way that’s easier for us to enrich the game world for the players and increase the likelihood of players seeing more content.

notes.title: Small Hotfix and Happy New Year
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

We are back to work on Adventure Craft for 2021! 

This is just a small update to fix a bug that was adding 10 Boost Damage to the main player character. The main character was meant to be doing 100 hit points of unarmed damage but due to the bug it was doing 1000 extra damage per hit on top of whatever weapon was being wielded.

So during the holidays everyone had super human strength!

This bug would have affected the game balance in a significant way so we apologize for any inconvenience that this caused. 

We are looking forward to continuing our work on Adventure Craft this year. We have many new features on the way and some nice surprises!

notes.title: Adventure Craft Update 1.1 is Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, 

We are happy to report that the Adventure Craft 1.1 update is now available in the main branch of the game. The 1.1 update brings a ton of new features, content updates and bug fixes. Now onto the details! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/6b3614fd7c2b0103e4567f1192387fe1aa2ad964.png[/img]

[b]Extended Day and Night Cycle[/b]
The day/night cycle has been slowed down again making for much longer days and nights, which allows for more time to explore or gather resources in the day but can make being out at night more dangerous.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/54bda6f108031b614ea0d252f8e98d143ffe4de4.png[/img]

[b]Respawning in your bed[/b]
After you die you will now respawn back in the last bed that you slept in, or if you die in a “portal world” like a cave system where you don't have a bed, you will respawn outside the portal.

Death Penalty Removed
You no longer will lose everything if you die twice in a row, you can now always venture back to where you died to retrieve your dropped inventory.

[b]Epic Criticals for weapons [/b]
The majority of weapons now have a chance to land an “Epic Critical” which is a double damage critical hit. Epic critical chance is typically half the chance of whatever the weapons current critical chance is set to.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/046fee8db11a87383d85bb16870ce10327037d15.jpg[/img]


[b]
Wiki Data Spreadsheet[/b]
The Spreadsheet that contains all the game’s recipes and other data is now available for public viewing. You can find it here. (Note: This spreadsheet is a work in progress, missing info will be updated, please inform us of any inconsistencies in the data)

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1QBOFHFp7Lq2CmBnUZR_C3Ldah8X1Wq9dKi4Eh4NfVbc/edit?usp=sharing

If you would like to help us move this data onto our Official Adventure Craft Wiki, you can find the wiki here.

https://adventurecraft.gamepedia.com/Adventure_Craft_Wiki
[b]
Town Updates[/b]

Town Graveyard[b]
[/b]Activity in the town graveyards has been increased. Haunted chests protected by poltergeists can now be farmed for special items, and a town grave keeper now roams the area hunting the undead. You may also encounter a powerful  Brute Vampire or Brute Ghost hunter in this area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/9d761d6794bf56bba6c1f015398d1748a5b27c20.jpg[/img]


Vampire Mansion
You can now enter the tomb at the back of the vampire mansion (if you have collected the keys) to fight the bosses inside. This is a tough battle that will require a Spectral Sword and/or Stake Guns to win. Having a party with you that is equipped with these types of weapons will make this battle much easier.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/c341d79ebac6dc8a12e99d02223058ae32be16ba.png[/img]

Town Farm
Activity in Town Farms has been increased. Farmhands will now gather wheat and leave piles that you can farm if you have a pitchfork. They will try and protect their harvest so beware of their dogs if you get too close. The activity inside pens has also been updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/e2889d6607a70a4ac092691ec0eee9400f8ee843.jpg[/img]


Town Center Weapon Shop
The town center weapon shop has had more weapons added to its inventory.

Misc Gameplay Updates

Dog Power 
An attack dog that has reached its final stage of evolution can now use its power which is an attack that will cause Fear to any nearby mob that isn't immune to Fear. Press N to activate the power. It has a 300 second cooldown. (There is no visual currently to show the attack but this will be added in a future update)

Clone Party Updates

Clone Speed: Clones will now match your speed if you use a speed increasing items so that they don't get left behind. 

Toggle Clone AI on off: You can now use the numbers 7 and 8 to toggle a clone’s AI on or off quickly. This is useful in battle when you need the clones to stop what they are doing and follow you. 

Goblin Tech Tree
We have adjusted the way that goblins camps evolve over time. Now you will see a pile of Goblin Supplies that will eventually activate. Once activated goblins will begin to spawn from it and try to deploy tents to expand their territory.

New Tile Maps

Voodudes
The Voodudes have now been given their own new biome along with a new weapon to craft. Their biome is also home to a new mob, The Brutal Voodude. Farm him to craft a Voodude Club, a heavy poisonous club that inflicts many status effects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/bfc74a4742f6bcbea12bffe22dbe93b4d63562e2.png[/img]

Stone Clan
There is a new faction of enemies in the world known as the Stone Clan. The Stone Clan is an order of Stone Clad Knights that wield powerful stone swords that can be upgraded up to 4 times. They hang out in a new rocky biome, following members of the clan with higher standing, mining stone etc.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/1ef63c87afcd133b976db6955e7ba88a6cede915.png[/img]

Cave Men and Women
This new rocky area is home to Cave Men and Women who are locked in a constant battle for supremacy. Explore the area and you may find the secret to crafting one of the Cave Women’s huge club weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/2747c75d93c80ef396a3f03f5773d75df3388338.png[/img]


Remixed existing Tile Maps for more variety
A collection of the existing Tile maps have been remixed to bring more variety to their gameplay experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/a99eb20a3b9417d57c82a57559a5bd62e535c5c0.png[/img]


New Armor
Bear Suit: Farm bears to create the Bear Suit Armor, each piece of this armor increases overall attack by 1 and adds half a heart to your life meter.


Bugs
Fixed Bug that caused the game to crash if you press the Dog Power Button
Fixed a bug that allowed a player to be locked inside a room in an NPC structure.
Fixed a bug that allowed an Iron or Steel Sword from transforming a Sabertooth Bubbler
Rainbow object left behind by fairey grenades now despawns after a period
Thornbull Pens will now die after a period
White Knight Sentry dogs updated to address some unpredictable behaviours 

Gameplay
Update artwork for Thorn Lords
Updated loot drops for Thorn Lords 
Updated item system for ransacking NPC wardrobes and cuppards.
Thorny Tentacles now have a chance to drop Thorny Nuggets on death
Thorny Tentacles will now seek out and transform trees in the Badlands
Honey piles inside Bear Caves are now lit 
Boarmen will now attempt to protect their totems
Using pickaxes on Boarmen totems will now yield more materials
Bears now have a chance to Haste when chasing the player 
Dark Ones are now vulnerable to Holy Water Grenades and will now catch on fire when hit by one
Sugar Cane can now be crushed into Sugar
Infectious zombies will now die at nightfall
Adjusted the range and attack physics of the Goblin Bully
Added handle mod for the Stone Hammer to make it faster to use
Added Machete Pop up Shops Near Thorn Forests
Mason is now vulnerable to Holy Water 



New Weapons
Leaf Sword
Honey Greatsword
Bear Tamer
Honey Bee Greatsword
Deacon’s Bell
Claymore 
Chainsaw Sword
Voodude Club 
Thorn Axe
Spectral Blade

Giant Cleaver

Mace

Steel Claymore

Polearm

Harpoon Gun

notes.title: Development Update 08/7/2020
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, 

We want to apologize for the lack of information concerning the next update to Adventure Craft. A lot has happened since the last update which has slowed down the already incredibly slow development for this project, but believe it or not, I have indeed worked on the game nearly every day since the last update and there is a substantial amount of new free content still coming by the end of the year.

Sorry for not posting regular information here on the Steam page. There have been some really lovely long-standing fans who have been with us from the beginning, many who had paid for the game, who deserve to know what's going on. Those early funds helped keep our heads above water and enabled us to keep the game alive during its initial development. So we apologize to all those folks and thank you for your support.

[b]The Future[/b]

On the bright side of things, I have very recently had some changes in my circumstances that will hopefully facilitate more work being done on the project so that we can finally complete the game's core experience, move the game out of Early Access, and provide more consistent content and information updates. 

We plan on continuing to enrich the free core Adventure Craft experience until it is something that is worth paying for. Once we achieve this we will then start the process of making the optional paid high level DLC dungeons, the first of which will be free for all existing customers who paid for the game's initial development. The core game will still receive updates and remain free. 

[b]What's coming in the next update?[/b]

Here are some images with descriptions of a few of the things that I've been working on that will be in the 1.1 Adventure Craft update.

We have spent time updating the artwork on the world to make it more beautiful and to add more visual interest and variety[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/37bb97b0c3706cc9bf333e9debe027f8a465bfbc.png[/img]

[b]Stone Clan[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/76fe8e25c9fd8f7b792531f0accdff0542288dbe.png[/img]

There is a new faction of enemies in the world known as the Stone Clan. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/4967a42181923b139189b50d63fa0423188e76f9.png[/img]

The Stone Clan is an order of Stone Clad Knights that wield powerful stone swords that can be upgraded up to 4 times. They hang out in a new rocky biome, following members of the clan with higher standing, mining stone etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/1ef63c87afcd133b976db6955e7ba88a6cede915.png[/img]
This little dude in the black armor is one of the Highest members of the Stone Clan. He is called a Stone Clan Duke. He carries the most powerful of the Stone Clan's swords and is typically seen leading lower level members of the Stone Clan around looking for trouble.

Berserk Psychos
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/b22465b047730892f7af73a6bdf1e3a61cec588f.png[/img]
These unpredictable guys hang out in their own new biome in the badlands. They will follow you around stalking you but will sometimes turn on you if a fight breaks out between you and other mobs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/5f92e8dcad452b97ab86983fd44b6456a9441d0a.png[/img]
Here you can see me holding one of the new weapons, the Iron Hook.

[b]Cave Women[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/2747c75d93c80ef396a3f03f5773d75df3388338.png[/img]
Another new Faction is cavemen and cavewomen. Cave Women are a "Brute" class humanoid that wield massive wooden clubs. Their weapons require Ancient Knowledge (a loot drop) that you can use to craft their awesome club.

[b]Tile Map Diving Art[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/37bb97b0c3706cc9bf333e9debe027f8a465bfbc.png[/img]
I have started adding large pieces of non-destructible environmental art to help divide the landscape. This creates more mazelike pathways through certain biomes and also prevents the player from building there in order to create more variety and richness in the visuals.

[b]The Deacon's Bell[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/fea6587fc19ee55391b985f6b0c81a2c7ad4bae6.png[/img]
The Deacon's Bell is a new weapon that can be crafted from new loot dropped by the Dark Congregation boss down in the cave systems. It shoots a golden fireball like the one that the Dark Congregation uses. The fireball will push enemies back and also sets close mobs on fire when it's rung.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/c80e5198daabaf417756a9535778036a96dc05ca.png[/img]
This Giant Cleaver can be crafted from loot dropped by a new Brutal Zombie that you will find roaming the graveyards tile maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/e1553bd9562ac36473e13af1d3387bbf5193a7ed.png[/img]
Here I am weilding a Dark Greatsword, one of the new darkness weapons. Also you can see here that the the artwork on some of the objects near the player spawn have had some updates. 

Goblin Tech Tree
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/92c9a8562000c7e963caaa362f9066fd3e5c01a4.png[/img]
Some new work has gone into how a mob camp can develop over time. We started with the Goblins around the spawn. You will see "goblin supplies" that can be used by goblins to establish small camps that will grow over time and need to be dealt with before becoming an issue. 

[b]Fishing Hole Updated[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/7ebd263b93763fa21692e4bbdc4ab6b25de98e64.png[/img]
There's a variety of updates to the fishing holes and fishing shops. And some new weapons that you can use to deal with Sabertooth Bubblers.

[b]Party Bullies[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/2e3a953b1f7a6bcaa781be9cc04ce207cdde33a0.png[/img]These pink bullies are new friendly mobs that will fight by your side and can transform normal goblins into friendly Party Goblins. A special item can also be acquired at the Dark Carnival to summon a Party Bully to help you win a tough battle. 

[b]Brutal Voodudes[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/bfc74a4742f6bcbea12bffe22dbe93b4d63562e2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/84573ae3fb23f61a806c07557e2ce3aa98b5c56b.png[/img]
The Voodudes have now been given their own new biome along with a new weapon to craft. Their biome is also home to a new mob, The Brutal Voodude. Farm him to craft a Voodude Club, a heavy poisonous club that inflicts many status effects.

[b]Flaming Greatsword[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/a2662c722518fc3dc0d662923a82210b507652a9.png[/img]
Use flame crystals found in the underground cave system to craft a Flaming Great sword, a deadly sword with high attack damage and high chance to cause burning. 

[b]Honey Bee Great Sword[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/b861b9a9918f96a53c2becea9a1ae21b4a188566.png[/img]
Venture into bear caves and farm the honey crystals you find inside to create this bear taming sword. It can transform a bear into a "Honeyed Bear" which will fight for you until it is killed.

This is just a small sample of what will come to Update 1.1. We have already made an enormous amount of new content and additions over and above what is listed above, but it would take far too long to list it all, and we want to keep some surprises for you guys as well. However, rest assured that there will be many more new weapons, items, monsters and biomes to enjoy. 

Thanks again for your time and patience. We hope to bring more news soon about when we can deploy this update. If you have any questions about the game please feel free to say hello on Twitter @iENDERi

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

This is just a quick news update to let people know what is going on with development at the moment. 
[b]
[url=https://adventurecraft.gamepedia.com/Adventure_Craft_Wiki]The Official Wiki[/url][/b]

Over the last few weeks, I have been working on establishing the Offical Wiki for Adventure Craft. An official wiki is something that I was initially planning on doing later, but after reading about a player's frustration with the lack of information about the game we decided to go ahead and get the ball rolling.

I have never worked on setting up a Wiki before so there was a bit of a learning curve but I think I have the hang of it now. I have started by creating pages with information on the game's numerous [url=https://adventurecraft.gamepedia.com/Category:Items]items [/url]and recipes. From there I will be working on getting all the pages set up for the enemies and characters and so on and so forth. 

Next, I will add more specific articles detailing more of the games other systems like the scripting of your party members' behavior etc.

I have been working on the Wiki full time over the last few weeks but now that it's got a fair amount of content I plan on reducing the overall time I spend on it and move focus back to finishing the game's beta branch so that it can be moved into the main game. 

[b]The next update[/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.054 is now available in the Testing Branch
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

We are happy to announce that Patch 1.054 is now available to try in the testing branch! If you would like to have access to this new content you simply need to opt in. There is a link at the bottom of this announcement that explains how.

Now onto what's inside patch 1.054!

[b]New Game Content[/b]

Updated Thorn Forests
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/0f1fa219c6b166e38480723d2f8062fce51feeb2.png[/img]
The Thorn Forests are some of the most dangerous areas in the game world. These tile maps are home to dense swarms of thorny tentacle monsters that can choke escape routes, giant bees that can transform enemies into weird honey mutants, thorn infected machete wielding psychopaths, and other weird plant based stuff that wants you dead.

The Thorn Pen saplings, deployed by Blooming Thornbulls,  will now grow over time eventually becoming Thornbull pens, giant plant monsters that spawn HUGE swarms of tentacle monsters and Thorn Lords.

Updated Thorn Lord minion spawning

Thorn Lords can spawn up to 5 thornbutts simultaneously. Thornbutts are small thorny masses that will move towards their prey before suddenly ramming into them doing damage with a 25% chance to poison. When defeated thornbutts now darken indicating that they can no longer move.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/688f037d3d8417463b53e4e13fb495fe0c3cd3d4.png[/img]

[b]Bear Caves[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/aa18a3ec597b93f2f4e42807302bef23b0d0eab4.png[/img]
Various biomes now have a chance to spawn a Bear cave. These small caves will spawn a few bears at the entrance during a certain time of the day and can also be freely entered to gather large amounts of honey from the stashes that the bears inside protect. These caves will also provide a way to farm the upcoming Bear Suit armor.

[b]Increased Standard Cave Activity[/b]
Increased overall mob activity in the standard caves making them much more unpredictable to explore.

[b]Updated Colossal Boar Border[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/b4cf0009203be60dd64fae65cf7bc34700ec6b11.png[/img]
The tile maps that surround the Colossal Boar Spawn have now been updated with a new enemy and more activity overall. Big game hunters with powerful rifles will hunt and fight with Boars and Boarman Snipers now appear in greater numbers with a higher fire rate and more health.

[b]New Enemy: Brutal Boarman[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/b4cf0009203be60dd64fae65cf7bc34700ec6b11.png[/img]
The Brutal Boarman patrols the border tile maps of the Colossal Boar. Like the Brutal Punk, Brutal Boarmen wander around rallying nearby boarmen, as well as un-aggroed boars into a roving gang looking for a fight. They wield massive Stone Boar Clubs and their attack can smash a green eyed Friendly Boarman into the dirt killing them instantly.

[b]New Weapons[/b]

[b]Stone Boar Club[/b]
Farm the Boarman Totems in the Colossal Boar Border to gather the materials needed to craft this powerful new Stone Club. The Stone Boar Club does 10 Attack Damage with a 75% critical hit chance. It also has a 100% chance to transform a normal hostile Boarman into a friendly Green Eyed Boarman on Death.

[b]Stunning Pine Fishing Net[/b]
Mod a standard Pine Fishing net with a "Fish Stunner" that you can find for sale in a Fishing Shop. This mod gives the Pine Fishing Net a high chance to stun a Sabertooth Bubbler.


[b]Miscellaneous Game Tweaks[/b]

Added Totem Planting Agents to spawn from Boarman Houses

[b]Updated Fishing Shops[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29325572/4bb320b20e3e7577aca3ecaa7ac968aa1f04830e.png[/img]
Fishing shops now have live in NPC's that will open the shop in the morning and lock the door at night while they sleep
Fishing Shop Keepers can no longer be attacked by the player
(Note: There is still a bug that may prevent a shop owner from returning to their shop if they are killed. We are working to address that)

Adjusted loot drops for punk builders
Adjusted the drop rate of Goblin Scrap from all goblins
Added frog spawns to fishing hole tile maps
Big Fish Hunter no longer has a chance to deploy Boar Bombs during flee
Broken Stone swords can now be repaired

[b]User Interface adjustments[/b]
Changed the Configure Clone AI button to say "Set AI" rather than just "AI"

[b]User Reported Bugs[/b]

Fixed Bug: Selling pearl necklace causes crash to certain shops ?
Fixed Bug: Selling Twine to the Inn crashes the game
Fixed Bug: Bread Description displaying as Bread Item Name during Gameplay
Fixed Bug: Infinite cash exploit with buying and selling items obtained from inn room wardrobes.
Fixed Bug: Where broken oak helmet was displaying as broken goblin helmet
Fixed label on basic stone helmet to correct name
Updated rabbit loot drops to drop rabbit pelts 50% on death

As mentioned above if you would like to access these new features then you need to opt in to the Adventure Craft Testing Branch.

How to opt in to a Beta Branch to a game on Steam. 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=182912431

Thanks so much for reading!
James
Follow me on Twitter: @iENDERi

notes.title: Update 1.05 is now available for testing.
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

Well, it is a relief to be able to make this post and to say that the 1.05 update is now in a playable state. We have been working on this for so long, so it's really good to get it into people's hands and we look forward to working with people on it. Finally! There is a huge amount that has been added and changed, and below you will see the major things listed. They only account for about a third of all the changes, but they are the most important ones from a player's perspective. All in all we hope that the changes make the game a more fun and rewarding experience.

We have now deployed the 1.05 update to a Testing Branch so that players can have a chance to play it and test it for bugs before we deploy it into the main game. The patch will stay in testing between 1-2 weeks before it gets added to the main game.  

If you would like to try the 1.05 Update you simply right click on the Adventure Craft title in your games list and select properties.Then click on the BETAS tab and select the Adventure Craft Testing branch of the game. 

This will give you access to the testing version of the game without affecting your main game save. To switch back to the normal version just right click on the testing version in your game list and switch it back to NONE in the Beta tab with the drop down menu.

Please keep in mind that the 1.05 update is very large and is still a work in progress. It contains many new features, items, and other content that has been internally tested but also contains many elements that are still incomplete or in need of tweaking. 

Please be sure to report any bugs, crashes or other weird things that you come across in the discussions section of the game's Steam page. We will be checking there daily to address anything that you find. 

[b]Patch Notes[/b]

Here's a list of the most significant changes that have been made since the last update.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]Players will no longer lose their entire held inventory if they die a second time, instead the players inventory will simply drop where the player died and will stay there until retrieved.

[/b]
[b]Towns[/b]
The biggest part of this update is the Towns that you can now find in the world. Towns are composed of several tile maps each with a different theme or purpose. 

You will know that a town is near when you enter the White Knight controlled town border tiles, which are full of bright white stone walls and other White Knight structures. In the town center you will find an Inn where you can spend the night, as well as static item shops that sell both common and unique items.

Additionally you will find a Farm, Graveyard, residential area that you can build your own structure on, a Ghetto or Slum area, as well a mysterious mansion. 

[b]Fishing Ponds[/b]

There are now several fishing ponds that will appear on the map where you can catch fish or get eaten by the giant fish that live there. Fishing tile maps are indicated by a fish icon on the map.  [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/462abf643e077ee708f3db7262f8b07d02c41af9.png[/img]

Acquire a fishing net and attack the places where you see disturbed water and a fish jumping out.

[b]Colossal Boars[/b]

The Boarmen worship Colossal Boars in this new tile map. These giant hairy pigs can be farmed to obtain items to craft a new set of Colossal Boar Armor. Big game hunters often carry special weapons that can make taking these creatures down a lot easier. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/1d70d7fb59a978d8a1516a87a6960d1ed0500f44.png[/img]

[b]Thorn Forests[/b]
Thorn Forests contain various new creatures and items. Currently it's a very dangerous area to explore and the items and treasures are still being worked on. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/27924936fed498b92badd98eee86b49d35a0ffdf.png[/img]

[b]
Additional Changes
[/b]

[b]UI Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Added two new quick select HUD elements for pet items 
[*] Added auto sort button above each inventory tab  
[/list]

Updated world map with new tile map icons 

Updated graphics for many tile maps 

Added steel recipes to caves and white knight area

Added throwable Dynamite 

Updated the inventory art on the acorn mine

Updated Acorn Grenade explosion

Added impact crater to  grenades 

Updated the art for all shoe icons

Updated various other art elements

Longer days and nights

Greatly increased the dogs attack damage

Explosives do much higher damage 

Decreased Bleeding chance on iron Sword from 15% to 7%

Decreased Bleeding Status Effect Damage over time from 2.5% to .5%

Broken Iron Swords can now be crushed into scrap metal

Bleeding Status effect is no longer renewable

Greatly increased the damage of all explosive weapons and items

Increased Bomb Attack Damage to  500

Increased Bleed duration from 20 to 30 seconds

Increased the drop rate of goblin loot from all goblins

Status indicator text on HUD now matches the color of the current status effect.

Treasure Chests now have a chance to drop scrap wood on death 

Updated boarman loot drops 

Empty Treasure chests now have a chance to drop scrap wood on hit 

Right clicking on a piece of equipment while a clone's inventory is selected will now equip the armor to the clone rather than the player

Increased chance that a boar will drop boar scrap on death

Decreased size of damage numbers and status effect text during hordes for better visibility

Increased throwable rock damage from 1 to 10, increased throw speed and added them as loot to rocks

Throwable rocks can no longer be crafted and must be found instead

Updated grenade descriptions to include damage and effects 

Some scrap stacks can now be combined to make leather

Punk Attacks Transform trash pile into bigger trash pile

Large Trash piles will spawn giant maggots that can transform into giant fly 
men 

Crab eggs are now poisonous unless cooked

Spiders now drop antivenom. Antidote recipe has been updated because of this

Added heart and hunger stats to food descriptions

[b]BUGS FIXES[/b]
[*] 
[*] Various minor bug fixes 
[*] 
[*] Removed Character knockback on grenade detonation 
[*] 
[*] Right clicking on a piece of equipment while a clone's inventory is selected will now equip the armor to the clone rather than the player
[/list]

notes.title: Update on Free to Play Price Change and Monetization
notes.content:
Hi, 

Thanks so much to everyone who responded to our "Fate of Adventure Craft" announcement! I was very touched by all the kind words about our game. It felt really good to read that. 

We have been communicating with Valve about the change over the past couple of days and we have been approved for Free to Play! We have also been advised that we will indeed be able to reward our existing paid players which I am really excited about.

They also advised us on our plan about setting up a subscription model which has informed us on how to move forward with monetization.

Here's a rough overview of my plan moving forward. 

[b]Obviously this is all subject to change, but this should give you a general idea of what's happening in the short term.[/b]

------------------------------------------------------------

Deploy Price change on July the 11th. From that point forward, the Core Game will now be offered PERMANENTLY for Free. All content updates to the Core Game will be free. Once the price change goes into effect we will...

Finish configuring the 1.05 update and get it ready to deploy.

Deploy 1.05 to the testing branch for one week.

After the test week Deploy 1.05 to the main game package.

Address any issues with 1.05.

From this point we would like to release an update every 1-2 weeks to the core game. First to a testing branch for a week of testing, and then moved into the main public game. (You will be able to opt in and test the patch and provide feedback before it gets deployed to the main game if you would like to.)

...........................

[b]Monetization[/b]

Rather than the subscription model...

All updates to the core game will remain Free. New recipes, items, Tile Maps, monsters, gameplay refinements etc, will be continually added to the core game to foster its continued evolution. 

We will periodically release Paid DLC in the form of "End Game Dungeons/Item Packages", the first of which will be automatically Free for existing Paid Players. 

The End Game Dungeon DLC will be high level "non persistent" worlds that will mainly appeal to people who have put enough time into the base game to have a set of weapons/equipment/items capable of surviving them. (I'll tell you more about how we plan on doing the DLC's and our plans for how they affect the Core game for Free players and Vice Versa as we move forward).

If you want insider info on this or have a question follow me on Twitter @iENDERi and I'll answer your questions.

notes.title: 23 New Images and an Update about version 1.05
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

We just wanted to post an update to let everyone know what is going on with the development of Adventure Craft. We realize that it has been a very long while since we have released an update for the game or posted any news, which has lead some folks to ask us whether or not the game is "dead" at this point and why there haven't been many news updates about the game's progress etc. 

So with this post we want to...

[list]
[*] address some of these questions and concerns
[*] inform you on where things are at and where they are going
[*] show you a small selection of some of the new things coming to the game
[/list]


[h1][b]So is the game dead?![/b][/h1]

The short answer is No, the game isn't dead. We have still been working on it since the last update was released nearly a year ago and we have no plans to abandon it.

[h1][b]Is the 1.05 update still coming this year?![/b][/h1]

No, the official update won't be coming until early 2019.

[h1][b]Why not? And why is it taking so long?![/b][/h1]

After the last update we decided to add full NPC Towns and NPC Structures to the world map. This ended up being a much larger undertaking than we had initially predicted.

The concept was to have villages of various sizes, from small "Single Tile Map"  villages to "Very Large Villages" composed of multiple Tile Maps. 

We decided that, rather than starting with the simple small villages, we would start with the large more complex villages first because the large villages would incorporate the majority of the new features that any other future village might contain and help inform the addition of the smaller villages later.

As we began implementing the large villages to the game world, we realized how much work was ahead of us, and that it wasn't going to be a simple as just throwing the villages in and testing them along side the community as with other updates. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/c108a095b993d3b423eee2572c3f213edfdd0a99.png[/img]

[i]A Large Village covers a 5x5 tile area of the world map and is comprised of 25 Tile Maps of various types, such as White Knight border Tiles, farms, a town center, town graveyard etc. Each individual tile map in the Large Villages also contains new characters, static shops, and various new items and weapons which affect existing areas of the map and systems.  [/i]

Since Edible Entertainment is comprised of only two people, one artist/game designer and one programmer, progress was very slow indeed!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/07abb02ab644704dfbdb9a199e2d6afa967d7917.png[/img]

[i]A posse of pitchfork wielding villagers out for a stroll down to the local vampire residence. [/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/c341d79ebac6dc8a12e99d02223058ae32be16ba.png[/img]

[i]A vampire and his minions enjoying the cool night air.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/83953ec560ada7dcfaf01ef7f784bc55d04ae00e.png[/img]

[i]Various new items. Fishing Nets, Dynamite, Holy Grenades, Big Game Guns, Harpoon Guns, Battle Axes, Machetes....[/i]

[h1][b]So now what?![/b][/h1]

So as mentioned above, we have been continually working on the game for about a year since the last update and we will continue to do so until the update is ready sometime in early 2019. Lots of new items, equipment, and weapons have already been added but we still have a lot to do before we can release it.

Thank you so much for your patience with this next update! We sincerely can't wait to get it into your hands and continue this journey together!

In the meantime we have selected a bunch of images to show a small taste of what's to come. These are in no particular order. 

[b]Continuing to Enhance the look of existing Tile Maps and Art Assets[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/d4b23d1fb7d8a947b187ed74c6ea9c51f6b3b872.png[/img]

[i]We have been updating the look of the game world with additional details and objects like this new grass that populates between dirt and grass.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/b1b80cdd972cb9ddc6e5b5648daa86d37a423f4e.png[/img]

[i]New foliage and details near water transitions for creatures to hide in, as well as new crafting materials to collect like these shells.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/6aafc066a5ecfe671e9b239c75855f05b4ac255d.png[/img]

[i]New Large "divider objects" that create maze like pathways through areas. 
[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/8eb2ccd2d77d88460d53fbd472ba8993aa3382bc.png[/img]

[i]In areas like the Badlands, this creates more opportunity to use the environment to  get away from dangerous enemies so that they can't simply run up to you and kill you if you need to flee because they will have to run around large things in the environment.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/54bda6f108031b614ea0d252f8e98d143ffe4de4.png[/img]

[i]Creepy Tentacles coming from the night time storms.[/i]

[h1][b]Thorn Forests[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/05ad3feaf6cadb8e0d032034596586068a424aa2.png[/img]

[i]Thorn Forests are dangerous new biomes full of lots of dangerous new creatures to fight and rare powerful items to acquire. 
[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/27924936fed498b92badd98eee86b49d35a0ffdf.png[/img]

[i]The Thorn Lord Creepeth[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/c674c121966cdf13e51032eb31cce75a95151155.png[/img]

[i]Giant thorn tentacles will burst from the ground in huge hordes seeking to kill anything that disturbs the ground. You will be able to craft special weapons that they are weak against to cut through their ranks in search of the treasures they protect.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/e96f51bb9cf842d1a294e6a80ca06820b1ed736b.png[/img]

[i]Strange Bulbs that can develop into giant plant monsters can be found throughout the Thorn Forest. Destroy them before they have a chance to grow up![/i] 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/b5448ff4af8a0be55fdcd35e8c963116fc3e79c8.png[/img]

[h1][b]Fishing[/b][/h1]

One of the new Tile Maps are Fishing Ponds that will be generated throughout the world.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/c7c027201509c9d21a06b830c3bd4603aaff8dfc.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/5c722000d90f65b98cb718c1867eb2347f50f852.png[/img]

[i]"Fishing Spots" will appear in Fishing Ponds that you can harvest fish from with the right equipment. You can recognize a Fishing Spot by the disturbed water and the fish periodically jumping out of the water.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/beb5c85cd36d67a93da83335666b8ddb70d23c09.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/308796a60b7e71cec8d09cde5b8443289bc19df6.png[/img]

[i]NPC's will also fish the ponds as well. Some are friendlier than others and you may have to protect yourself from angry fishermen seeking to fish the same spot that you are. [/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/fd23d72bc318f86297e899a93bfdf3915f188208.png[/img]

[i]You will also find very large dangerous fish that will try to eat you when you come into their territory.
[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/5cf598d8de3b81d0e89a0e6ff031cfc72cfa86fe.png[/img]

You will also find "Fishing Shops" near fishing ponds to purchase various fishing goods like nets, and other fishing gear. 

[h1][b]New Enemies[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/2c4f521bb3ce7444890f51578bc7ed77657918de.png[/img]

[i]There are also many new enemies that you will encounter like the Goblin Bully.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/24b66fd2f47417ebee79a854236013b342bbb629.png[/img]

[i]Some of the existing zombies will now take more effort to kill and will crawl after you leaving a bloody trail behind. [/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/82ed8084a42ce037eaad1764969fccaec186cbae.png[/img]

[i]Additionally, these zombies may leave "infectious gore" behind that can turn other mobs into "Infectious Zombies". These are slow moving zombie mutants that can also turn other mobs, creating slow moving large zombie hordes that can leave a path of destruction and decay if not eradicated. [/i]


Thanks for reading! Thanks for your patience and thank you for your continued support!

To stay updated with any news about the game or to ask me any questions directly please follow me on Twitter @iENDERi

notes.title: 15 New images and information on the Upcoming 1.05 NPC Village Update!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We have had our heads down working hard on the next big update for Adventure Craft and have not had much time to post any news in a while, but we wanted to let everyone know that we are still alive. A few people have wondered if we have abandoned the project but we assure you all that we have not abandoned it! In fact we can't wait for you to play what we have in store for the next update!

So we decided to post some new images and talk a little bit about each one as another "preview post" for the upcoming 1.05 NPC Villages update. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/a47b659b93b3f568cac419719e44c693b42cdfd6.png[/img]

[b]Please note that all images posted here are works in progress and do not reflect the final quality. [/b] So here we go!

[b]NPC Villages[/b]
The major focus of 1.05 is the addition of NPC villages and NPC Structures to the World Map. The villages will vary in size from small vulnerable single tile map villages, to large 25 Tile White Knight protected Towns like you see here.

[b]A White Knight Village on the Map[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/275596bbf66cfd7fa53da84b785ebca089727d18.png[/img]

The White Knight Villages will expand the overall presence of the White Knights in the world, including adding new members of The White Knight's Order like the "High White Knight"

[b]High White Knight Patrolling with a Crew[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/d367667ea317f244fc9704798d7805c457a63af2.png[/img]

Neighborhoods are populated by NPC's just going about their daily lives. NPC's will leave and come home, have wake/sleep cycles, and can make their own decisions about how to interact with you based on your behavior. NPC residents will defend their property if you are discovered! 

[b]Town Graveyard[/b]
Town Graveyards are spooky places with creepy things that can sometimes creep into town causing various problems for a town's inhabitants. 

[b]Town Center[/b]
The Town Center contains static shops that will give you reliable access to items, weapons etc, as well as the usual pop up shops and other fun activities.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/d025e1117b77fde139281f11b13271282a239fab.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/6b63e840d052bb15e51be3cef96d7b2c293e0a71.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/eb0c9f7d4e31fcbd84ac3487b21fbada76eb4088.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.05 Preview, NPC Villages, New Boss, and more!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

We have been hard at work putting together the Adventure Craft 1.05 update and because of it's size, it's taking a bit longer than expected. So we just wanted to make a post showing what we are working on and share a little bit of what you can look forward to when the update is released.

(Note: All images are of works in progress and will change between now and the release of this update)

[h1]NPC Villages![/h1]

One of the first big new additions are the NPC Villages/Towns Biomes! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/1e43ec3c5656b87d8b7e699431418f6865ea2325.png[/img]

NPC Villages are large biomes where you can find NPCs living and going about their daily lives, Static Shops, and village based gameplay scenarios. The Village biomes are made up of a "Town Border" tile map that surrounds and protects the biome, an "Inner Area" composed  of varying "Districts", and a "Town Center". Whilst NPC villages are generally much safer than most other areas of the game world, their border may still be attacked by roaming monsters and sneakier creatures who have "ways" of finding their way inside.

First we will talk about the Town Border which is occupied by the mysterious White Knights. Here you will find the White Knights going about their business, training, and getting ready for their nightly battle against the forces of darkness, as well as various White Knight structures and curiosities. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/f06f862d16a090ff0b031cf0288a60b81b4e2245.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/f5518f19e099106e8f0b0707f2e136e51bd73f73.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/9057f3a51097a86e2794d130eb555e51ff885a92.png[/img]

[h1]Town Center[/h1]

Past the White Knight occupied Town Border is the "Inner Area" where you will find a variety of tile maps that make up the districts that rest of the village is composed of, as well as the "Town Center" that lies in the middle of the Biome.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/93a853802c2d72096bc4f5fad55472d27ec8a604.png[/img]

The Town Center will feature a set of Static Shops and Businesses that will provide reliable access to many of the game's items as well as special items and fun diversions that can only be found in the Town Center.

Here is an image of the General Store in the Town Center.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/15aa9b2835d5a33e9d6e7fa8c150952cfc6b2a21.png[/img]

The town center will also feature an Inn! Grab a drink at the bar, or stay the night. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/297ba527c17b02eac3b53bf3edeccae0c514365c.png[/img]

[h1]Class Based Neighborhoods.[/h1] 

The inner area of the village will feature neighborhood like tile maps that are themed after a sort of "social class" system. These tile maps will be set up as Slums, Middle Class and Upper Class neighborhoods for NPCs. Each neighborhood will have different content and gameplay scenarios based on the class of NPC's that live there. The NPCs that live there are also being updated to behave as if they really occupy their dwellings, including going to bed within specified time ranges, leaving and returning home as part of a routine, and reacting to the player actions within their homes.

Here are a few images of the "Slum Neighborhood" tile map.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/7dcddd8910fbff0801f5b2df1b51d93f79cc152f.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/62e8d642496b27f787cf71751e2853b134a711bf.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/42ef1305b1aa72f6070a387f40cbd4e83f77dbae.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/9da6ec37047845d0401a69df8f9504a54716e219.png[/img]

[h1]Town Graveyards.[/h1]

The Town Graveyard tile map is a unique place within a village because unlike the other districts which are generally safe, it can be a dangerous place to visit particularly at night.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/429dca15338bc3dbeb4b8146ee9c0f7ecab2e649.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/ca9c39105725128e1943ef7ed54a670a082c7255.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/cff8b70914f1f48bf5e522f9e9342172afe28028.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/4bd91be6809f058cc7e992fecdd59d61dab7d1ea.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/19fbc17aa94b15d2a21972202c13dbd2b7b73e76.png[/img]

[h1]Real Estate Districts[/h1]
Whilst you won't be able to simply build structures in the main districts of a village due to the many permanent NPC structures and objects within them, you WILL have the option to use your gold to purchase a deed to one of the "Real Estate" tile maps within the village. Once purchased you will be able to build up a base within one of these virtually empty tile maps.

Farms
Just like the other districts, the NPC farm district will contain a farmhouse, and other farm related items and gameplay.


[h1]New Boss and Equipment "Spoiler Alert"[/h1]


The Colossal Boar is a HUGE new boss enemy that will provide a significant challenge to defeat. Covered in the weapons of defeated warriors foolish enough to try and take him down, you will find him in being worshiped by the Boarmen in the center of the new Boarman Biome. Defeating Colossal Boars will provide you with the materials needed to Create the Colossal Boar Armor and Weapons. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/fb6571c8eade332e4e1b20d8cedfa1b005a0030b.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/1d70d7fb59a978d8a1516a87a6960d1ed0500f44.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/ffd626452970513fbe0fa2f3cfd5a5b9fea66a68.png[/img]

Colossal Boar Armor

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/99f82bfb6ff7384f1fe33bc004b7c56dac1d5c06.png[/img]


[h1]Some final words about another upcoming change that may or not be included in 1.05 but is in the pipeline for the VERY near future.[/h1]

As the world and content of Adventure Craft continues to expand, more powerful new monsters, events, and areas will be continuously added, along with the valuable rewards for overcoming them. Because of the procedural generation aspect of the game, the chance of swift and unforeseen deaths will increase. Particularly during unprepared inventory retrieval which could cost you everything. Because of this we are currently in the midst of evaluating the penalty for second death in the game, and designing additional options for inventory retrieval. 

Thank you so much for reading this post! We hope that you are enjoying the game!

@iENDERi

[h1]Town Center[/h1]

Past the White Knight occupied Town Border is the "Inner Area" where you will find a variety of tile maps that make up the districts that rest of the village is composed of, as well as the "Town Center" that lies in the middle of the Biome.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/93a853802c2d72096bc4f5fad55472d27ec8a604.png[/img]

The Town Center will feature a set of Static Shops and Businesses that will provide reliable access to many of the game's items as well as special items and fun diversions that can only be found in the Town Center.

Here is an image of the General Store in the Town Center.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/15aa9b2835d5a33e9d6e7fa8c150952cfc6b2a21.png[/img]

The town center will also feature an Inn! Grab a drink at the bar, or stay the night. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/297ba527c17b02eac3b53bf3edeccae0c514365c.png[/img]

[h1]Class Based Neighborhoods.[/h1] 

The inner area of the village will feature neighborhood like tile maps that are themed after a sort of "social class" system. These tile maps will be set up as Slums, Middle Class and Upper Class neighborhoods for NPCs. Each neighborhood will have different content and gameplay scenarios based on the class of NPC's that live there. The NPCs that live there are also being updated to behave as if they really occupy their dwellings, including going to bed within specified time ranges, leaving and returning home as part of a routine, and reacting to the player actions within their homes.

Here are a few images of the "Slum Neighborhood" tile map.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/7dcddd8910fbff0801f5b2df1b51d93f79cc152f.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/9da6ec37047845d0401a69df8f9504a54716e219.png[/img]

[h1]Town Graveyards.[/h1]

The Town Graveyard tile map is a unique place within a village because unlike the other districts which are generally safe, it can be a dangerous place to visit particularly at night.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/429dca15338bc3dbeb4b8146ee9c0f7ecab2e649.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/ca9c39105725128e1943ef7ed54a670a082c7255.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/19fbc17aa94b15d2a21972202c13dbd2b7b73e76.png[/img]

[h1]Real Estate Districts[/h1]
Whilst you won't be able to simply build structures in the main districts of a village due to the many permanent NPC structures and objects within them, you WILL have the option to use your gold to purchase a deed to one of the "Real Estate" tile maps within the village. Once purchased you will be able to build up a base within one of these virtually empty tile maps.

Farms
Just like the other districts, the NPC farm district will contain a farmhouse, and other farm related items and gameplay.


[h1]New Boss and Equipment "Spoiler Alert"[/h1]


The Colossal Boar is a HUGE new boss enemy that will provide a significant challenge to defeat. Covered in the weapons of defeated warriors foolish enough to try and take him down, you will find him in being worshiped by the Boarmen in the center of the new Boarman Biome. Defeating Colossal Boars will provide you with the materials needed to Create the Colossal Boar Armor and Weapons. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/fb6571c8eade332e4e1b20d8cedfa1b005a0030b.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/1d70d7fb59a978d8a1516a87a6960d1ed0500f44.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/ffd626452970513fbe0fa2f3cfd5a5b9fea66a68.png[/img]

Colossal Boar Armor

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29325572/99f82bfb6ff7384f1fe33bc004b7c56dac1d5c06.png[/img]


[h1]Some final words about another upcoming change that may or not be included in 1.05 but is in the pipeline for the VERY near future.[/h1]

As the world and content of Adventure Craft continues to expand, more powerful new monsters, events, and areas will be continuously added, along with the valuable rewards for overcoming them. Because of the procedural generation aspect of the game, the chance of swift and unforeseen deaths will increase. Particularly during unprepared inventory retrieval which could cost you everything. Because of this we are currently in the midst of evaluating the penalty for second death in the game, and designing additional options for inventory retrieval. 

Thank you so much for reading this post! We hope that you are enjoying the game!
