notes.title: 1.04 is HERE! New House Customizations, Home Defense Gameplay, Offline Mode and More!
notes.content:
Hi! We are happy to announce that 1.04 is now available for download! In this update we have added a bunch of new home customization items, new home defense gameplay, and more gameplay balancing. Here are the patch notes!

[b]New House Customization Items[/b]
New items added to the Shops in the Home Customization Store

[b]Paula's Plantlife (New Shop)[/b]
[list]
[*]10 new decorative plants
[*]2 new Floors
[/list]
[b]Bradlee's Place[/b]
[list]
[*]12 new beds
[/list]
[b]Muriel's Room[/b]
[list]
[*]6 new Decorative Furniture Items
[/list]
[b]Larry's[/b]
[list]
[*]6 new Back Wall Decorations
[*]8 new Decorative Lamps
[*]4 new "Corner Lights"
[*]6 new Wall Decorations
[*]10 new Floors
[/list]
[b]Randy's[/b]
[list]
[*]10 New Dinner Tables
[*]8 New Rugs
[/list]
[b]Gameplay and Content[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased durability of all Armor Pieces by approximately 25%
[*]Boars now have 30% chance to drop scrap on death.
[*]Boar Carcasses now have chance to drop Boar Scrap
[*]Increased Goblin Leather loot and scrap drops on Goblin and Goblin Heavy
[*]Breaking an Iron Axe now results in a Broken Iron Axe that you can repair with scrap metal
[*]Breaking an Iron Pickaxe now results in a Broken Iron Pickaxe that you can repair with scrap metal
[*]Updated art on windows making them more visible when the sledgehammer is equipped
[*]House windows are now transparent
[*]Updated the art on player structures to better indicate exterior doors when outside of a structure
[*]Getting close to a house window while outside will now reveal room interiors without going inside
[*]Increased ATK power of Acorn Grenades from 20 to 40
[*]Increased ATK power of Acorn Mines from 20 to 40
[*]Friendly NPC's now more likely to follow players into a structure
[*]Combat Knife now increases loot chance on skinnable animal carcasses the same as the hunting knife
[*]Updated the descriptions on the boxing gloves as well as the punk fist
[/list]

[b]Home Defense Gameplay[/b]
Enemies now have the ability to "Detect" the player when they are hiding inside a structure and may try to force their way in. Detection is only possible when both the player and the enemy are within the "Detect Radius" of a Wall, Door or Window. The Detect Radius is different for each wall type.

Wall: Small Detect Radius
Door: Medium Detect Radius
Window: Large Detect Radius (The player can attack mobs and vice versa through windows. This allows the player to throw grenades out of the window to kill attacking mobs.)

If the player is detected, monsters will begin attacking the structure, damaging the walls. Players can cancel the aggro of monsters attacking a structure by exiting the structure, but detection will be renewed if players re-enter the structure and re-enter the detect radius that a mob is standing in.

[b]Repairing Damaged Walls[/b]
The player can repair damaged wall simply by attacking the wall.
Currently walls have 1000 hit points
Each wall repair costs one oak log and will repair the wall approximately 25% of its total health.
[b]NOTE: Windows cannot be repaired. They must be replaced.[/b]

[b]Interface[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a player status effects indicator above the armor meter of the HUD (useful when you are immortal inside of a crowd of enemies)
[*]Added a no teleporters warning upon entering a tile map where teleporters are not allowed
[*]Added Option to turn off Camera Shake
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Bug that made it difficult to select and move furniture
[*]Fixed Bug that allowed lights inside structures to draw above the roof
[*]Fixed Bug that messed up quick crafting when the inventory tab of a quick crafted item is full. Now the item can be crafted and will be dropped on the ground, allowing you to craft it and then make space in your inventory.

[b]Offline Mode Now Enabled (Workaround)[/b]
We have received some complaints that the game is not playable in Steam's Offline mode. We have implemented some code so that should allow Adventure Craft to be played in Offline Mode for up to 3 days after the last time that the Steam Client has been online to check for the latest version of the game. Hope this helps.

notes.title: 1.03 is HERE! Expanded Home Building and more!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

We are happy to announce that 1.03 is here and it brings with it all new expanded structure building options and more!

In addition to expanded structures there are also new gameplay and balance changes and new content! Here are the patch notes!

[h1]Expanded Structure Building[/h1]
The locks are off! You can now build 3 new structure shapes! All structures can now be linked together, which allows for building large homes with individual connected rooms!

Here is a building guide to get you started. 
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1113851414

[h1]Interface[/h1]
[*]Added "Quick Repair" buttons to the equip menu (these shortcuts for repairing equipment will appear next to your equipped item, if the item is damaged and you have the repair materials in your inventory)

[h1]General Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]White Knights (appearing above ground) Active End time changed from 6am to 4am 
[*]Re-balanced Overall Punk Loot Drops
[*]Decreased drop chance of bent crowbar on Crowbar Punk from 75% to 50% on death
[*]Iron Swords now become "Broken Iron Swords" if broken in combat/harvesting and can now be repaired
[*]Increased the light output of all lamp furniture
[*]Decreased sell value of oak sticks from 75 gold to 25 gold
[*]Increased the light output of lamps
[*]Fixed bug that caused Giant Boars to drop the actual Boar God Club on death rather than the recipe.
[*] Fixed bug that caused the game to go into windowed mode if you pressed esc while the game was paused
[/list]

[h1]Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added additional Enemy Swarm Events 
[*]Added new weapon "Boxing Gloves" 
[*]Added new weapon "Punk Fist"
[*]Added Punk Fist and Boxing Gloves recipes to Brutal Punk
[*]Added Dark Skin loot drop to Chomps
[/list]

[h1]Character Specific Balancing[/h1]

[b]Brutal Punk [/b]
[list]
[*]Brutal Punk attack now has 25% chance to cause berserk.
[*]Updated art on Brutal Punks to make them stand out more from the pack
[/list]

[h1]Attack Dog (Buffs and Item Rebalance)[/h1]
Increased Dog KO time from 60 to 240 seconds

[b]Increased Attack Dog Overall Power and Life Statistics[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased Attack Dog (Puppy) attack from 1 to 2
[*]Increased Attack Dog (Adolescent) attack from 2 to 4
[*]Increased Attack Dog (Mature) attack from 3 to 6
[*]Increased Attack Dog (Full Grown) attack from 4 to 8

[*]Increased Attack Dog (Puppy) HP from  20 to 80
[*]Increased Attack Dog (Adolescent) HP from  40 to 160
[*]Increased Attack Dog (Mature) HP from  80 to 320

notes.title: Update 1.01 is Now live!
notes.content:
Hi! We are happy to announce that Adventure Craft 1.01 is now live! Huge thanks to everyone who has provided feedback! Here are the patch notes. 

[b]UPDATE 1.01[/b]

[b] INTERFACE[/b]
[list]

[*]Added "quick cut/crush" buttons to recipes in the recipe window. These buttons will appear above a recipe ingredient when you have the item and recipe that the ingredient is derived from, through cutting or crushing, in your inventory. Pressing the "quick cc" button will automatically process your materials so that you don't have to leave the recipe window as often when crafting
[*]Added a search field to the recipe menu to filter the recipe list to help find recipes faster
[*]The workbench crafting menu will now automatically be available if you are standing near a deployed workbench when you open the inventory 
[*]Added a "SHOW REPAIR" recipe toggle button. This button will toggle display of only REPAIR recipes in a category.
[*]Added a "NEW" button to recipe menu. This button will toggle display of ONLY new recipes in a category
[/list]
[b] GAMEPLAY AND CONTENT[/b]
[list]
[*]Added the ability to craft "trunk drawers" to trunks and weapon and equipment lockers which allows you to double or triple the storage space of these containers.
[*]Added the trunk drawer recipe to drop from destroyed trees
[*]Added deadly new full moon scenarios 
[*]Added punk scrap picks to Punk drops
[*]Added "punk signage" object to badlands (drops nails when hit with pipe axe)
[*]Added an Indicator to Punk Structures that require Pipe Pickaxe to destroy
[*]Punk structures now drop nails when hit with a Pipe Pickaxe
[*]Friendlies spawned from the "mysterious device" at the spawn will now attempt to kite enemies when they fight 
[*]Pipes and rusty wedges are now dropped by Punk House and HQ builders
[*]Punk Builders now have the ability to change certain dead trees into "punk signage"
[*]Dead trees (in the badlands)  can now be destroyed with the pipe axe (they don't drop loot yet though)
[/list]
[b] BALANCE[/b]
[list]
[*]Decreased the speed at which time passes slightly, creating a slightly longer day and night cycle
[*]Decreased drop rate of clone inventory bags from golden chests
[*]Decreased the durability of the "Call to Worship" from 25 to 20
[*]Slightly decreased loot probability on boar carcasses when using the hunting knife
[*]Increased enemy presence in caves
[*]Increased the overall availability and drop rate of nails
[*]Increased the spawn count of sugar cane in marshy areas
[*]Increased the repair cost of a damaged "Call to Worship" from 2 to 5 Golden Syrup
[*]Increased the repair cost of a completely broken "Call to Worship" to 2 golden ropes and 5 Golden syrup
[*]Increased resistances to transformation attacks on stronger enemies
[*]Increased Dark Zombies' attack poison chance from 25% to 35%
[*]Increased Dark Monstrosity chase speed from 295 to 325
[*]Increased Dark Monstrosity maximum simultaneous spawn from a Dark Zombie portal from 3 to 4
[*]A Chomp's attack now has 25% chance to poison
[/list]
[b] BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Made optimizations to reduce cpu usage
[*]Fixed bug where Mer would drop mer shoes as loot rather than the recipe.
[*]Fixed bug where holy water was free in shops
[*]Fixed bug on some blueprint drops that made them harder to see at night since they were being lit by the environment
[*]Fixed a bug where clones could heal dogs with non dog items like potions
[*]Added better Unicode file system support
[/list]
